scene_setup: The trio — Valion, Pashion, and El Haddah — stand at the southern edge of Skysong Harbor on Route 2. Tutorial complete, starters at their sides, Professor Liora's parting words still fresh. The harbor glows behind them; ahead, grassy platforms of Breeze Path ride the warm trade winds. Wind banners snap overhead. The party's active goal is simple: leave the harbor together and begin the real journey toward Gym 1 and the wider Celestide Isles. Optional callback: if Team Drift's crystal theft at the Wind Festival wasn't fully resolved at the table, a Drift scout may appear on the path with a moral choice — help civilians, gather proof, or confront.

objectives.description: Leave Skysong Harbor via Route 2 — Southern Approach
Traverse Breeze Path toward Zephyra's Gym
Encounter wild Pokémon on Breeze Path (Pidgey, Hoppip, Celestide Mareep sighting)
Optional Team Drift encounter — moral choice on the route

dm_notes: Episode 2 — party is past Session 1 (Wind Festival, met Professor Liora, obtained starters, completed tutorial). Keep tone family-friendly. Rotate active_trainer_id among Valion, Pashion, and El Haddah for three-PC table play. Wind currents are atmospheric — use for narration on Breeze Path. Do not force Gym 1 this session unless players choose to rush. Track Pokédex discoveries in continuity.discovered_pokemon per Expansion §10.

planned_encounters.notes: First Breeze Path wild encounter. Pidgey lv5-7. Easy intro to route travel.
Optional Celestide Mareep (cstm_celestide_mareep) sighting — may flee; discovery counts for Pokédex even if not caught.
Optional Kaelix or Mira callback. Moral choice: help civilians, gather proof, or confront. Drift can retreat.
